title: How long do freeze-dried eggs actually last in storage?
description: What determines how long freeze-dried eggs stay good in storage, and the prep and packaging steps that get you there.
author: Jack Ferrence
disclosure: Sublime Pantry has no affiliate relationships as of publication. No link in this article earns us money.

sources.title: Freeze Drying Eggs: What You Need to Know

bodyHtml:
Eggs must be fully cooked, scrambled, before they go into the freeze dryer — raw eggs are not recommended for home freeze-drying, per manufacturer guidance.

How long storage actually lasts

University extension guidance is consistent on this: properly freeze-dried, packaged food stored cool, dark, and dry can last for extended periods, though the exact number depends on your dryness and packaging.

Packaging that works

Mylar bags with oxygen absorbers are the most common home storage method reported for freeze-dried eggs.
